title: Financial Instruments and Exchange Act (Act No. 25 of 1948), art. 24 annual securities report
citation: Act No. 25 of 1948 (昭和二十三年法律第二十五号), art. 24; formerly the Securities and Exchange Act
evidence: Supplementary Provisions art. 1 (e-Gov text): 「この法律は、その成立の日から三十日を経過した日からこれを施行する。但し、第二章の規定は、その施行の日から六十日、第六十五条の規定は、その施行の日から六箇月を経過した日から、これを施行する。」 Promulgated 1948-04-13 (Law element PromulgateMonth=04 PromulgateDay=13, https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/api/2/law_file/xml/323AC0000000025_20260812_508AC0000000064). The page gives a formula and no date, so in_force stays null.
notes: Art. 24 requires an issuer to file an annual securities report (有価証券報告書). The sustainability content of that report is set in the Cabinet Office Order (jp-cao-disclosure-order). e-Gov serves point-in-time texts from 2016-04-01; earlier texts are not served. Languages: Japanese (53 records; the only official language) and English (2 records, unofficial, Japanese Law Translation, row JP-JLT-TRANSLATION): 2023-06-01 from https://www.japaneselawtranslation.go.jp/en/laws/view/4633 (last version shown Act No. 68 of 2022) and 2020-05-01 from view 3631 (Act No. 28 of 2019). Each is stored under the e-Gov version whose Japanese text the translation's Japanese lines match. English not stored: view 4405 (same state as view 4633, an earlier edition of that translation); view 3429 (Act No. 46 of 2017: its Japanese text fits the stored versions 2018-04-01 to 2019-06-07 equally, and the version of the act it names, 2017-12-01, fits worse); views 2355 and 1911 (state of 2010 and 2006, before the first stored version 2016-04-01). The other stored versions have no English translation: JLT serves one state per edition. Where several amending acts share one enforcement date, the revision of the latest-promulgated amending act is stored. Revisions with a provisional date are not stored: 2027-03-31, 2027-07-22, 2028-01-01 and two on 2028-06-13 (e-Gov shows an outer-limit or linked date, not a fixed one).

title: Cabinet Office Order on Disclosure of Corporate Affairs (Ministry of Finance Order No. 5 of 1973), as amended 2023-01-31 (sustainability information in the annual securities report)
citation: Ministry of Finance Order No. 5 of 1973 (昭和四十八年大蔵省令第五号); amended by Cabinet Office Order No. 11 of 2023 (令和五年内閣府令第十一号), promulgated 2023-01-31
evidence: Supplementary Provisions item 1 (e-Gov text): 「この省令は、公布の日から施行する。ただし、第二十条の規定は、昭和四十八年四月一日から施行する。」 Promulgated 1973-01-30 (Law element, https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/api/2/law_file/xml/348M50000040005_20170401_429M60000002008).
notes: Implements art. 24 of jp-fiea. The 2023 amendment (Cabinet Office Order No. 11 of 2023, e-Gov revisions 2023-01-31 and 2023-04-01) added the sustainability and human-capital items to the annual report forms. Those forms are PDF attachments (Fig src=./pict/*.pdf in the e-Gov XML) and are not in the stored text; the stored text of 2023-01-31 to 2026-02-19 contains no word サステナビリティ. The stored text of 2026-02-20 onwards contains サステナビリティ関連記載事項 provisions. Earliest stored version 2017-04-01 (e-Gov serves nothing older). Languages: Japanese (37 records; the only official language) and English (2 records, unofficial, Japanese Law Translation, row JP-JLT-TRANSLATION): 2024-08-01 from https://www.japaneselawtranslation.go.jp/en/laws/view/5206 (last version shown Cabinet Office Order No. 53 of 2024) and 2017-07-14 from view 3384 (Cabinet Office Order No. 40 of 2017). English not stored: view 4965 (labelled Cabinet Office Order No. 11 of 2023, but its download is byte-identical to view 3384, so its text is the 2017 state and does not match the amendment it names; the 2023-01-31 and 2023-04-01 versions have no English); views 2688 and 2341 (state of 2014 and 2008, before the first stored version 2017-04-01). The Japanese Law Translation forms (views 3564, 4957) are PDF files and are not stored. Same-date rule as jp-fiea.

title: Act on Promotion of Global Warming Countermeasures (Act No. 117 of 1998), art. 26 GHG calculation, reporting and publication
citation: Act No. 117 of 1998 (平成十年法律第百十七号), art. 26
evidence: Supplementary Provisions art. 1 (e-Gov text): 「この法律は、公布の日から起算して六月を超えない範囲内において政令で定める日から施行する。ただし、第一条、第二条第一項、第二項及び第四項並びに第三条から第六条までの規定は、公布の日から施行する。」 Promulgated 1998-10-09 (Law element, https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/api/2/law_file/xml/410AC0000000117_20260101_506AC0000000056).
notes: First date is the promulgation day, when arts. 1 to 6 took effect. The rest, including the reporting duty, started on a day set by Cabinet order, which no e-Gov page opened here states. Art. 26: specified emitters (特定排出者) report their GHG emissions each year to the competent minister. e-Gov serves point-in-time texts from 2016-05-27; earlier texts are not served. Detail is in jp-gw-reporting-order. Languages: Japanese (12 records; the only official language) and English (1 record, unofficial, Japanese Law Translation, row JP-JLT-TRANSLATION): 2022-07-01 from https://www.japaneselawtranslation.go.jp/en/laws/view/4479 (last version shown Act No. 68 of 2022). The page names Act No. 68 of 2022, whose two stored e-Gov versions (2022-06-17, 2025-06-01) do not match the translation's Japanese text; the 2022-07-01 version does (all but 7 of 652 Japanese lines found: 4 are supplementary-provision headings the translation adds, 3 are body lines worded differently from e-Gov). English not stored: view 3796 (last version Act No. 57 of 2006, before the first stored version 2016-05-27).

title: Act on Promotion of a Smooth Transition to a Decarbonized Growth-Oriented Economic Structure (GX Promotion Act, Act No. 32 of 2023), GX surcharge and emissions trading
citation: Act No. 32 of 2023 (令和五年法律第三十二号); amended by Act No. 30 and Act No. 52 of 2025
evidence: Supplementary Provisions art. 1 (e-Gov text): 「この法律は、公布の日から起算して三月を超えない範囲内において政令で定める日から施行する。ただし、次の各号に掲げる規定は、当該各号に定める日から施行する。」 item 1: 附則第十条の規定 公布の日. Promulgated 2023-05-19 (Law element, https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/api/2/law_file/xml/505AC0000000032_20230519_000000000000000).
notes: 2023-05-19 is the day the first provisions took effect; the e-Gov revision list also shows 2023-06-30 and 2024-02-16. The surcharge provisions (賦課金, 特定事業者負担金) are in the text from the 2023-06-30 revision; the emissions allowance provisions (排出枠) grow from 15 mentions to 130 in the 2026-04-01 revision, which is where the emissions trading scheme text appears. Only the Act and its two implementing instruments below are in scope; other GX instruments (the order on business fields, the low-carbon hydrogen act) are not. Languages: Japanese only (7 records; the only official language). English: Japanese Law Translation searched again on 2026-11-02 by title (脱炭素成長型経済構造への円滑な移行の推進に関する法律, "Decarbonized Growth") with untranslated titles included; no translation of the Act, only an outline of an amending act (https://www.japaneselawtranslation.go.jp/en/laws/view/4971) and an outline of the low-carbon hydrogen act (view 4732); outlines are not translations of the law text and are not stored.

title: SSBJ Sustainability Disclosure Standards (inaugural standards issued 2025-03-05; three standards amended 2026-03-13), with the FSA phase-in for Prime Market issuers
citation: Sustainability Standards Board of Japan, SSBJ Standards, issued 2025/3/5, amended 2026/3/13
evidence: SSBJ Standards page (opened 2026-11-02) lists "SSBJ issues Inaugural Sustainability Disclosure Standards to be applied in Japan 2025/3/5" and "SSBJ amends three Sustainability Disclosure Standards ... 2026/3/13" and states no effective date. FSA roadmap (https://www.fsa.go.jp/en/news/2026/20260409/02.pdf, "Released January 8, 2026"): "Prime market-listed companies ... will be required to prepare annual securities reports in accordance with the SSBJ Standards, beginning with the largest companies by market capitalization", first group ¥3 trillion or more, fiscal year ending March 2027. A roadmap is not a commencement clause, so in_force stays null.
notes: The Standards are issued by a private standard setter and become binding through the Cabinet Office Order and the FSA roadmap, not by themselves. The SSBJ site says the Standards are available in Japanese only. The brief gave the host www.ssbj-j.jp, which does not resolve (CONNECT 502 from the cloud address); the site is www.ssb-j.jp. The existing register row for the FSA roadmap (fsa.go.jp/en/news/2026/20260409/02.pdf) is a policy paper and maps to no entry; it keeps its row with a notes sentence.

title: Japan's Corporate Governance Code (Tokyo Stock Exchange, revised 21 July 2026; earlier revisions June 2015, June 2018, June 2021)
citation: Japan's Corporate Governance Code, incorporated into the TSE listing rules (comply or explain)
evidence: JPX Corporate Governance Code page (opened 2026-11-02): "Update : Jul. 21, 2026" and "Japan's Corporate Governance Code (Revised July 2026)"; the English file is marked "Provisional translation" and dated "21 July, 2026". No page or file opened states a commencement date, so in_force stays null.
notes: The brief named the 2021 revision and its TCFD-based disclosure principle. The JPX page now serves the July 2026 revision as the current text; the word TCFD does not occur in its English file. The 2021 revision is listed under Previous Revisions. The Code is soft law: Prime and Standard Market companies must explain non-compliance with any principle. No translation stored.
